brief:
Settlers prevented Palestinian citizens from grazing livestock in pastures near their encampment in Khirbet al-Hadidiya in the northern Jordan Valley on Saturday, Shehab Wire reported. The blockade barred herders from accessing grazing land adjacent to their settlement in the region.

The incident occurred as occupation forces and settlers have intensified their activity across the northern Jordan Valley. Palestinians in the area rely on pastoral herding for their livelihoods, and access to grazing grounds has become increasingly contested as Israeli settlement expansion continues in the territory.
